Nina learned a lot about art. Nina likes snowy days best. Both of them like fish and juice. The family sits in the same pew every Sunday.

Last Thursday, Nina and Owen went to the bank counter. Nina usually has fish for breakfast. Nina thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, she dreams of studying medicine in the USA.
Nina and Owen had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. Owen is interested in reading. In fact, the stadium was full of cheering fans.
Nina is going to travel to Rome in April. They took many photos at the repair shop. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bank counter by bike.
